engagement.model: Syngeneic Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) subcutaneous tumours in immunocompetent C57BL/6 mice: VEGFR TKI (famitinib 2022, lenvatinib 2026) added to radiotherapy plus PD-1/PD-L1 blockade
engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC9715775). Published 2022-10-24 while the camrelizumab plus famitinib NSCLC cohorts (NCT04346381, primary completion 2022-06-22) were unreported and the paper cites no trial; no earlier conference disclosure found, so scored prospective, not retrodiction.
engagement.note: LLC tumours read CD8+ TIL, M1 TAM and MDSC by flow; no on-treatment immune readout exists from famitinib- or lenvatinib-treated NSCLC patients.
engagement.short: Mouse immune PD readouts never measured in patients
engagement.quote: Compared with radioimmunotherapy, the addition of famitinib further promoted the infiltration of CD8+ T cells and M1 type tumor associated macrophages, and reduced the number of myeloid suppressor cells.
engagement.judgement: One track for both LLC runs: same cell line (LLC), host (C57BL/6), RT schedule (3 x 8 Gy), checkpoint antibody dose (10 mg/kg) and prediction (a VEGFR TKI potentiates radio-immunotherapy); only the member drug differs. A lung-specific immunocompetent system, so distinct from the draft's cross-indication CT26/BNL isografts (syngeneic-ct26-bnl-mouse-lenvatinib-anti-pd1) and from the immunodeficient human xenograft track. Opening entry at first use; the model's PD readouts are tumour immune-cell counts that no NSCLC trial of a member drug has measured on treatment.
engagement.reason: Mouse immune readouts not measured in patients

dose.model: Syngeneic Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) subcutaneous tumours in immunocompetent C57BL/6 mice: VEGFR TKI (famitinib 2022, lenvatinib 2026) added to radiotherapy plus PD-1/PD-L1 blockade
dose.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC9715775). Published 2022-10-24 while the camrelizumab plus famitinib NSCLC cohorts (NCT04346381, primary completion 2022-06-22) were unreported and the paper cites no trial; no earlier conference disclosure found, so scored prospective, not retrodiction.
dose.note: Famitinib 5 mg/kg (lenvatinib 4 mg/kg in 2026) daily in mice; no human-equivalent exposure stated; patients got famitinib 20 mg once daily.
dose.quote: Famitinib (5 mg/kg, N685200402) was given daily by intragastric administration from days 1 to 14
dose.judgement: One track for both LLC runs: same cell line (LLC), host (C57BL/6), RT schedule (3 x 8 Gy), checkpoint antibody dose (10 mg/kg) and prediction (a VEGFR TKI potentiates radio-immunotherapy); only the member drug differs. A lung-specific immunocompetent system, so distinct from the draft's cross-indication CT26/BNL isografts (syngeneic-ct26-bnl-mouse-lenvatinib-anti-pd1) and from the immunodeficient human xenograft track. Neither LLC paper states a mouse-to-human exposure match, so, as the draft scores the H460 and RET tracks, there is nothing to compare with the 20 mg famitinib or 20 mg lenvatinib clinical doses: untested.

efficacy.model: Syngeneic Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) subcutaneous tumours in immunocompetent C57BL/6 mice: VEGFR TKI (famitinib 2022, lenvatinib 2026) added to radiotherapy plus PD-1/PD-L1 blockade
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC9715775). Published 2022-10-24 while the camrelizumab plus famitinib NSCLC cohorts (NCT04346381, primary completion 2022-06-22) were unreported and the paper cites no trial; no earlier conference disclosure found, so scored prospective, not retrodiction.
efficacy.note: Famitinib added to RT plus anti-PD-1 beat RT plus anti-PD-1 in LLC tumours; the camrelizumab plus famitinib NSCLC cohorts were still unreported.
efficacy.short: Famitinib triple beat radio-immunotherapy in LLC
efficacy.quote: In a mouse model, the triple therapy of famitinib, radiotherapy and immunotherapy had the most dramatic antitumor activity.
efficacy.judgement: One track for both LLC runs: same cell line (LLC), host (C57BL/6), RT schedule (3 x 8 Gy), checkpoint antibody dose (10 mg/kg) and prediction (a VEGFR TKI potentiates radio-immunotherapy); only the member drug differs. A lung-specific immunocompetent system, so distinct from the draft's cross-indication CT26/BNL isografts (syngeneic-ct26-bnl-mouse-lenvatinib-anti-pd1) and from the immunodeficient human xenograft track. Opening entry; groups were control, RT, anti-PD-1, RT + famitinib, RT + anti-PD-1 and the triple (n = 5 each), so the prediction is an add-on effect of famitinib over radio-immunotherapy.

efficacy.model: Syngeneic Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) subcutaneous tumours in immunocompetent C57BL/6 mice: VEGFR TKI (famitinib 2022, lenvatinib 2026) added to radiotherapy plus PD-1/PD-L1 blockade
efficacy.population: Unselected NSCLC: first-line PD-L1 TPS >=1% (n=41) and post chemo-immunotherapy (n=40) cohorts of NCT04346381
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of both cohort papers (open access, PMC10882294 and PMC11087418); NCT04346381 has no results posted, so registry_date is null. Pairing made here: neither paper cites the LLC model.
efficacy.note: Single-arm camrelizumab plus famitinib cohorts (ORR 53.7% first-line, 7.5% post chemo-IO) lack RT and a famitinib-free arm; randomized phase 3s terminated or unreported.
efficacy.short: Single-arm doublet cohorts; no add-on test
efficacy.quote: the combination regimen of camrelizumab and famitinib achieved an ORR of 53.7% (95% CI 37.4% to 69.3%) and a DCR of 92.7% (95% CI 80.1% to 98.5%).
efficacy.judgement: Untested, not same + partial: the model predicted that famitinib adds to radio-immunotherapy, and a single-arm doublet without RT or a famitinib-free comparator cannot test an add-on effect; the ORR shows the doublet is active, which the draft already credits to the xenograft track. The controlled tests never read out: NCT04619433 (camrelizumab + chemo +/- famitinib, phase 3) terminated by sponsor at n = 48, NCT05106335 (vs docetaxel) terminated at n = 1 for R&D strategy, NCT05042375 (vs pembrolizumab, n = 450) status unknown with no results (ClinicalTrials.gov, read 2026-11-05). If the checker accepts single-arm activity in the predicted direction as a comparison (as the draft does for Hida 2019), this becomes same with source_calls_it partial and magnitude direction_only.

patient_trials.quote: The median PFS was 16.6 months (95% CI 8.3 to not reached), and OS data were not yet mature, with an estimated 12-month OS rate of 76.8% (95% CI 60.0% to 87.3%).
The ORR and DCR with this combination regimen were 7.5% (95% CI, 1.6-20.4) and 80.0% (95% CI, 64.4-90.9), respectively.

efficacy.model: Syngeneic Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) subcutaneous tumours in immunocompetent C57BL/6 mice: VEGFR TKI (famitinib 2022, lenvatinib 2026) added to radiotherapy plus PD-1/PD-L1 blockade
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC12773621): received 2025-08-14, accepted 2025-12-23, published 2026-01-02; groups control, RT, RT + anti-PD-L1, triple (n = 8); no lenvatinib + anti-PD-L1 arm without RT; LEAP-006/007/008 are not cited.
efficacy.note: Lenvatinib 4 mg/kg added to RT plus anti-PD-L1 extended LLC survival 29.5 to 34 days; no NSCLC trial of that triple exists.
efficacy.short: Post-LEAP lenvatinib triple in LLC; no trial
efficacy.quote: The triple-combination (RT + anti-PD-L1 + Lenvatinib) significantly suppressed tumor progression (P < 0.05) and extended median survival (34 vs. 29.5 days, P < 0.05) versus dual therapy.
efficacy.judgement: Not scored as a retrodiction (retrodiction false, status untested): the run post-dates the LEAP failures (LEAP-007 results 2022-06-02, LEAP-008 2024-08-22, LEAP-006 2025-02-21) but never ran the LEAP regimen (no lenvatinib + checkpoint arm without RT), does not cite LEAP, and predicts a triple (RT + anti-PD-L1 + lenvatinib) that no NSCLC trial has tested (ClinicalTrials.gov lenvatinib + radiotherapy in lung cancer: none, 2026-11-05). Under decision 10 it is a fresh prospective prediction awaiting its trial. If rule question 5 is settled the other way (any post-failure model of the lenvatinib + checkpoint pairing is a retrodiction), this entry becomes contra with retrodiction true, because the model did not reproduce the human null. Same track as the famitinib run (see track note).
efficacy.reason: Triple regimen never tested in NSCLC patients

considered_not_added: Famitinib + HS-10296 (almonertinib) in NCI-H1975 and PC-9 xenografts (Thorac Cancer 2021, PMID 33656275, doi 10.1111/1759-7714.13902): human NSCLC cell-line xenografts in immunodeficient mice, the draft's nsclc-human-xenograft-immunodeficient-mouse track; a member-drug entry for that track, not a new system. Patient side would be NCT03904823 (famitinib + HS-10296 phase 2, status unknown, no results) and the n = 6 EGFR-mutant subgroup of NCT04346381; nothing to score.

Other lenvatinib NSCLC cell-line xenografts (Anticancer Res 2021, PMID 34083277; Exp Ther Med 2020, PMID 31853327) and vorolanib/CM082 EGFR-mutant NSCLC xenografts with gefitinib (Thorac Cancer 2020, PMID 32368855; Mol Ther Oncolytics 2022, PMID 35252556): same immunodeficient human-xenograft system as the existing track.

Lenvatinib Simcyp PBPK model filed in the 2015 DTC NDA (206947 ClinPharmR Appendix 2): perpetrator-only (lenvatinib on midazolam and repaglinide), predicted AUC ratios below 1.25 and was accepted for the label without any clinical DDI study, so there is no patient comparison; drug-level, not an NSCLC prediction, and if tracked anywhere belongs to the thyroid-cancer context. The ketoconazole and rifampicin victim studies were clinical, not model predictions.

Lenvatinib population PK-PD of serum biomarkers (CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol 2024, PMID 38528813, doi 10.1002/psp4.13130): fitted on 558 radioiodine-refractory DTC patients; descriptive, no NSCLC prediction.
Lenvatinib + anti-PD-1 in an inducible transgenic thyroid cancer model (Thyroid 2022, PMID 34641722): thyroid, cross-indication; never compared with NSCLC patients.

RET-fusion NSCLC PDX and cell models (Dis Model Mech 2020, PMID 33318047; cabozantinib, RXDX-105) and lung adenocarcinoma PDOs (Clin Cancer Res 2021, PMID 34083237; pralsetinib, poziotinib): non-member drugs, as the checker already excluded.

Patient-derived NSCLC organoids, PDX co-clinical trials, zebrafish xenografts, humanized mice, ex-vivo drug sensitivity, human genetic or challenge models with a member drug: no source found (abstract-scoped Europe PMC searches returned no relevant hit).

Camrelizumab + famitinib in previously treated NSCLC (ChiCTR1900026641, Ther Adv Med Oncol 2025) and in pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma (CAPSTONE, NCT04888429): patient side only, already in the draft's patient_trials on the xenograft track.

IBI318 (PD-1/PD-L1 bispecific) + lenvatinib in ICI-resistant NSCLC (Nat Commun 2025, PMID 41398162): patient side only, title-level (not read); a lenvatinib + checkpoint pairing without RT, so it does not test the LLC track's triple.

Famitinib monotherapy or chemo-combination NSCLC trials (NCT02356991 placebo-controlled phase 2, suspended by sponsor; NCT02766140 famitinib + docetaxel phase 3, terminated for recruitment): no results and no famitinib NSCLC model preceded them.
